summary:
Implemented a rotated iPhone-first slice on the Tire And Wheel Lab.

Added `tires.html#tire-handoff-builder` with Flat, Pressure, After Work, and Buying scenarios. Each can update routes, copy/share the handoff, and save it into existing Garage Notes. Also added search coverage, updated the iPhone bottom bar, bumped the service worker to `v355`, updated Anton state/status, and expanded smoke coverage.

Next safe slice: real-iPhone review of the Tire Handoff Builder, Anton/Home status clarity, or a practical Diagnostics/Quick Sheet follow-up.
